children: (NYSE: GIC), a value-added national distributor and source for industrial equipment and supplies, will exhibit at Booth #449 during Independent Hotel Show Miami 2026, taking place September 16–17 at the Miami Beach Convention Center.

Global Industrial will showcase its broad portfolio of products and solutions designed to help luxury, boutique and independent hotels operate efficiently and deliver exceptional guest experiences. The Company’s offerings support housekeeping, operating supplies and equipment (OS&E), furniture and décor, foodservice, and maintenance and facility operations across both guest-facing and back-of-house environments. Together, these solutions help hotels uphold brand standards, improve staff productivity and enhance the overall guest experience.

Independent Hotel Show Miami brings together hotel owners, operators and hospitality professionals from across North America to explore new products, ideas and innovations shaping the future of the industry.

"Today's hotel operators are balancing rising guest expectations with increasing pressure to operate more efficiently," said Greg Rangnow, National Director of Hospitality at Global Industrial. "We're looking forward to connecting with hospitality professionals at Independent Hotel Show Miami to better understand their evolving needs and share practical solutions that can help simplify operations, improve efficiency and support memorable guest experiences."

Attendees can visit Booth #449 to explore a wide range of Global Industrial products that support every aspect of hotel operations including housekeeping carts, vacuums, floor scrubbers, janitorial storage cabinets, workbenches, wire shelving, utility carts, cleaning supplies, food preparation tables, appliances, disposables, floor mats, personal protective equipment (PPE), packaged terminal air conditioners (PTACs), air conditioners, fans, air purifiers, patio furniture and poolside products.

Global Industrial representatives will be available throughout the show to discuss the Company's capabilities across operating supplies and equipment (OS&E), furniture, fixtures and equipment (FF&E), and facility operations, as well as its extensive assortment of national and exclusive brands, digital procurement tools and value-added services designed to simplify sourcing for hospitality organizations and help keep their properties operating at their best.

(NYSE: GIC) is a leading distributor of high-quality, industrial-strength equipment and supplies, serving organizations of all sizes across a wide range of industries. With more than 75 years of experience, customers rely on Global Industrial for its broad portfolio of national and private brands, trusted service, and focus on value.
